rows.text: The Blessings of Remembrance are embodied in Ice, enhancing Freeze effects and buffs.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Stephen added something to the stage. He said ransacking and smashing things are two essential experiences in games.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: That's the download terminal. Go give it a try.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Look, on the left are the virtual friends in your brain, and on the right are teammates already downloaded into the system cache.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Take me with you so you can get four people in the team. This also maximizes the effects of the Remembrance Blessing.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: To extend the session, the system created a concept of "domains." Go through the teleporter into the next zone.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "Uh oh, THEY're here..."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: One enemy after another falls before you. Oh my, you are unstoppable! Just like the heroes of myth and legend! You can't help but laugh as you swing your baseball bat and take down a beast that dares to challenge you. You are getting carried away by the bliss — wait, what the heck just happened?
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Continue...
"This punk has figured it out again. I have to get Screwllum to edit THEIR data once more..."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Continue...

"Akivili! Akivili!" A cheerful voice laughs. "Is that really you? Or is some tiny being playing a fatal joke on me — well, I'd love to welcome you with open arms, but I don't have any arms! I'm just a false god imprisoned within a simulation, after all!" There's something magical about THEIR words that causes you to completely relax.
rows.speaker: Aha

rows.text: Continue...
Blessings of Elation likes to surprise people, and is useful for characters with Follow-Up ATKs.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Continue...

"A question for you, my friend. When can a fake become the real thing?" — You seem to see (but actually don't) them wink at you — "The answer is... When you believe it to be real! Come on, geniuses. You almost fooled me for a second there! It's okay. I'll forget everything and wait for you to trick me again! So long, Akivili."
rows.speaker: Aha

rows.text: Continue...

"That's Aha the Elation," Herta explains sullenly. "A very elusive Aeon who probably figured out that THEY are a simulation. But I don't think THEY even mind it. THEY are very chatty. Just pinch your nose and have a chat with THEM. Thanks in advance."
Finish.

"Great job. That's it for today. I've chatted with a few of my collaborators, and we've decided to re-double our efforts. Next time you come back, you'll enjoy our official version of Simulated Universe."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: When did you chat with them?
What tricks are you trying to pull this time?

"While you were testing," Herta replies. "We have methods of communication far more powerful than those possessed by the IPC or the Intelligentsia Guild. As far as people with our IQ are concerned, this communication is highly efficient."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "Pretty much a complete overhaul of an upgrade," Herta replies. "Screwllum and Ruan Mei didn't think much about it, but Stephen is thrilled to pieces. I bet he thinks we're really developing a game here."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "Stephen Lloyd has come up with a bunch of different ideas for making the Simulated Universe more fun. It won't help us attract more Aeons, but it might just help you have more fun." Herta sighs.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Exit.

The Simulated Universe will be closed for a while. We want to give the whole thing a big overhaul, and think about what to do with Aha. Next time you will play the official version of the Simulated Universe, the test version will be abandoned.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: What a shame! I was just getting addicted.
It's okay. I'm not interested either.
What is up with Aha?
According to Stephen, you'll be even more addicted in future versions, believe it or not.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: That guy's enthusiasm is just unreal...
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Thanks for your honesty.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Elation is a very strange Aeon. THEY are both confused and clear-minded, and not as stubborn as the other Aeons. Aha won't stay confined to a single concept. THEY may have seen right through the nature of the Simulated Universe.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: You can go. I'll message you when I'm ready.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Hang on. I still have questions.
You better beg me to come back next time.
Alright. Goodbye, Herta.
Yes?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Are the Aeons in there really simulations?
Have you decided on what to do with Aha?
Who's this Stephen you keep going on about?
Forget it, it's nothing.
Ha, do you find THEM awe-inspiring, too? A virtual Aeon is not the same as any old AI. Ruan Mei and I came up with a way to connect virtual Aeons with THEIR real Paths.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Aeons in the Simulated Universe are the equivalent of a terminal, and THEIR divinity and wisdom come from the real Aeon. Otherwise, what would be the value in any information we get?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: I have a basic consensus with Screwllum. First, he'll try reducing the partiality values of the simulated Aha, even going as far as blocking THEIR Intra-Cognition — but that's a little dangerous and may attract the real Elation...
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: If we feel that method is unfeasible, then we'll probably leave this Aha to play however THEY like, while isolating THEM from communicating with the other simulated Aeons.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Oh, he's our fourth partner, member #84, Stephen "Weirdo" Lloyd. That guy's a genius with no interest in using his abilities, and spends two-thirds of his time in his adoptive father's fruit shop.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: He can't even get himself excited about something as cool as the Simulated Universe. Stephen did us a favor and asked to remain anonymous — he doesn't want to make a big splash at all. Perhaps some geniuses wish they weren't one.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: If I have to, then I will.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: By the way, there is a Simulated Universe Index over there, you can check it out if you have nothing else to do. But if you're not interested then forget it.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Is it not human nature to collect?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Hey, the Index is on the right. Don't go the wrong way.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: It may help and motivate you with your test of the Simulated Universe... But it could also be a bit redundant. Well, I'm not sure.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: I never thought Aha would show up... Looks like I'll have to deploy the official version. We have to spend some time on upgrading, the test version will be abandoned.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: What a shame! I was just getting addicted.
It's okay. I'm not interested either.
What is up with Aha?
Oh, that's alright. The update only takes a few seconds. Stephen is particularly enthusiastic, and the content's all ready to go.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Thanks for your honesty.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Elation is a very strange Aeon. THEY are both confused and clear-minded, and not as stubborn as the other Aeons. Aha won't stay confined to a single concept. THEY may have seen right through the nature of the Simulated Universe.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: You'll be able to re-enter the Simulated Universe soon. The update has quite a lot of changes.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Hang on. I still have questions.
Alright.
Yes?
